response.sql: WITH per_coin AS (SELECT feecoin, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_reb, AVG((rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_gap FROM fees GROUP BY feecoin), bench AS (SELECT AVG(avg_reb) AS b FROM per_coin), kept AS (SELECT p.avg_reb, p.avg_gap, p.avg_reb - bench.b AS excess FROM per_coin p CROSS JOIN bench WHERE p.avg_reb > bench.b) SELECT AVG(avg_reb) AS avg_of_avg_rebate_total, AVG(avg_gap) AS avg_of_avg_relative_gap, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM kept

assumptions.assumption: Records with NULL feecoin form their own group (a NULL group in GROUP BY), and that group counts equally in the benchmark if its average rebate total is not NULL.
Per-currency averages skip NULL rebtotal and NULL gap values (including gaps undefined from a zero or NULL feerate); zero rebates are included as real values.
